objects.invariant: nullable on upgrade for legacy assets; governed manufacturer or software publisher is required before E03 operational readiness can pass
warranty types are governed catalogue entries rather than free text
hardware warranty stores manufacturer, type, warranty/support dates, evidence, verifier and optimistic version
software license contract stores complete contractual entitlement metadata and evidence without raw license key material
third-party provider authorization scopes manufacturer, product/object type, geography, period, service levels and escalation contacts
third-party support coverage snapshots authorized provider scope and never rewrites manufacturer warranty dates
each contractual version is retained append-only with reason, evidence reference and immutable snapshot
contractual mutations are replay-safe through payload-bound idempotency keys
deadline events are emitted at most once per contractual date and threshold
Partner, Organization, IAM and RSOT identifiers remain weak references with no cross-context foreign keys
